title: Smashed Cheeseburger Sliders for a Group
description:
In this edition of Epicurious 101, professional chef and culinary instructor Frank Proto demonstrates how to make the best cheeseburger sliders at home. If you need to feed a crowd fast, sliders are your secret weapon; small, quick to assemble, and easily batchable, these delicious beef sliders in Hawaiian rolls (or Brioche Buns) are sure to go down a treat at any occasion.
https://www.msn.com/en-us/foodanddrink/cookingschool/the-best-cheeseburger-sliders-you-ll-ever-make/vi-AA1MFGce
ingredients: 2-3 packets of small Brioche buns (10) or Hawaiian rolls (24)
1 packet or so American cheese slices (or you favorite)
Assorted toppings (dill pickle slices, tomato slices, lettuce, bacon)
½ stick butter and 2 minced garlic cloves and chopped parsley
directions: Sauté the onions in a little olive oil until nicely soft and browned, adding the garlic in the last minute or so.
Make a little garlic butter in a pan or microwave.
Press – Smash – the meat flatly into a sheet pan (won’t take up a full 9x13 pan). Season liberally with salt & pepper.
Slice the rolls horizontally and open up the halves, with the bottoms closely packed on a sheet pan.
Start to build your desired burger with the preferred toppings – the same for everyone, or using individual preferences: maybe some cheese and pickle to start.
Broil the meat for about 5 minutes. Pour off any liquid that accumulates. Maybe separate the meat into 2 big chunks for easy transfer to the closely packed buns.
Finish dressing the sliders: condiment, onions, etc., more cheese and then the tops.
Brush the tops with some garlic butter, maybe laced with some parsley or chopped chives for color.
Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake in a hot oven (400 degrees) for about 5 minutes.
